_comment: Canonical Turbo package index. This is a STATIC, git-versioned, curated registry — there is no dynamic registry service and no auth. Publishing a package is a pull request that appends one object to `packages` below. Each object: { "name" (unique, matches the turbo_modules dir name), "repo" ("owner/name" on GitHub), "description", "categories" (array of lowercase tags), optional "min_turbo_version" (semver the package needs), optional "homepage" (URL). Entries are the six first-party packages that live under `packages/<name>/` in this repository; each has a `src/lib.tb` entry point and a passing `tests/` suite. See docs/packages.md for the full schema and publishing flow.

packages.name: turbo-cli-args
packages.description: Flag and positional argument parsing over an argv string array. Supports --name=value, --name value, boolean switches, and positionals.

packages.name: turbo-dotenv
packages.description: Load a .env file into a HashMap<str, str>. Handles comments, blank lines, quotes, whitespace, and the export prefix.

packages.name: turbo-http-router
packages.description: Path + method routing for the built-in HTTP server using a HashMap<str, fn(str)->str> dispatch table, with :param / wildcard matching helpers.

packages.name: turbo-logger
packages.description: Leveled logging (debug/info/warn/error) with level filtering and optional timestamps, in a single reconfigurable handle.

packages.name: turbo-sqlite
packages.description: An ergonomic, thin wrapper over the raw sqlite_* builtins: exec-with-params, scalar and column queries, row counts, and a migration helper.

packages.name: turbo-test-assertions
packages.description: Expressive assertion helpers for @test functions — string, integer, comparison, and Result assertions with self-describing failure messages.
